items.title: Candido Camero — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Well, even though they were dancers, the trio of Carmen and Rolando and I, after the trio Chano with Cacha and Pepe were two different styles.

ctx.x: Speaking of the show, tell me your impressions of Chano Pozo and Cacha’s show? That is, what distinguished that couple’s show from the show of Carmen and Rolando of which you were a part.
Well, even though they were dancers, the trio of Carmen and Rolando and I, after the trio Chano with Cacha and Pepe were two different styles.
